angle: New required parameter on the universal status-registration sink called by all 9 resource controllers
difficulty_notes: AddNamespacedResource is the operator's single funnel point where every reconciler registers a successfully synced resource into the Grafana CR status. It is not an interface method — it is a concrete method on *Grafana. The blast radius is therefore a flat call-site fan-out: every controller that drives the reconcile loop must be updated. Models that stop at obvious production files will miss api/v1beta1/grafana_types_test.go which calls the method directly eight times. Models that over-extend will incorrectly include RemoveNamespacedResource callers, which are not affected. The 'dryRun bool' framing is realistic — operators commonly add dry-run gates to status-mutating methods — which prevents models from dismissing the question as hypothetical.
